# XRechnung test suite samples

Unchanged copies of invoices from the XRechnung test suite of KoSIT (Koordinierungsstelle für
IT-Standards): <https://github.com/itplr-kosit/xrechnung-testsuite>, commit `1ce1daf` (2026-09-04),
folder `src/test/business-cases/standard/`. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0, see `LICENSE` in
this folder.

All 14 files are accepted by the KoSIT validator 1.6.3 with the XRechnung 3.0.2 validator
configuration of 2026-08-31 (see the workflow README, "Checking against the KoSIT validator").
